name: supa_crawl_knowledge
description: Search and inspect the persistent Supa-Crawl-Chat knowledge base (Supabase/pgvector). Use for semantic search over already-crawled sites, listing indexed sites, crawl status, stored pages/chunks, and corpus health. Complements crawl_url (live pages) and brave_search_llm_context (web). Brave-augmented RAG chat lives in Supa-Crawl-Chat's own /api/chat UI, not here—this tool only calls read-only HTTP APIs. Does not start crawls or mutate data.

action.description: Operation: search (default), list_sites, site (metadata for one site), site_status, site_pages, page, page_chunks, health (corpus stats), crawl_activity (all sites + job summary).

threshold.description: Similarity threshold for semantic search, 0-1. Lower broadens results. Default 0.3.

limit.description: Max results: search up to 100; list_sites cap of sites returned up to 100; site_pages up to 1000.

text_only.description: For action=search, keyword/text search instead of embeddings.

site_id.description: Filter search by site, or required for site/site_status/site_pages.

site_name.description: For action=search: optional site name or URL substring filter (API query param site_name).

after.description: For action=search: ISO datetime; only results with crawled_at after this when metadata exists.

include_search_content.description: For action=search: include full text content per hit (larger payload). Default false.

search_content_chars.description: For action=search with include_search_content: max characters per result (API default 2000, max 20000 here).

dedupe.description: For action=search: one best hit per source URL (API default true).

include_chunks.description: For list_sites/site_pages, include chunk rows in listing.

include_pages_content.description: For site_pages: include page body in list (larger). Default false.

pages_list_content_chars.description: For site_pages with include_pages_content: trim each page body (API max 20000).

content_chars.description: For page/page_chunks: max content characters per item. Default 8000 for page, 4000 for chunks. Max 20000.

base_url.description: Override Supa-Crawl-Chat base URL. Otherwise SUPA_CRAWL_CHAT_URL or http://localhost:8001.
